responsibility: This file implements the AArch64 backend’s late RTL pass for Branch Target Identification hardening. Enabled by AArch64 branch-protection options and scheduled via the target pass pipeline before branch shortening, it walks RTL basic blocks and inserts BTI landing-pad instructions at function entries that may be reached by indirect calls and at labels that can be reached by indirect jumps, including preserved labels, non-local goto targets, jump-table destinations, and setjmp/longjmp return points; it also recognizes existing PACIASP/PACIBSP prologue signing so as not to add redundant entry protection, making this file the target-specific pass that materializes BTI security annotations in generated AArch64 code.
